subject: ZetaOps trial orchestration & access plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Lawson <jane.lawson@zetaops.com>, Tim O'Rourke <tim@zetaops.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZetaOps trial orchestration & access plan

Hi Jane/Tim — thanks again for a productive call today. Quick recap and proposed plan to get the POC started next week. Happy to adjust based on your security/ops constraints.

Recap of what we heard (success criteria):
- Integrate Redwood inference API into ZetaOps sandbox to validate 3 sample flows (search re-ranking, chat assistant, batch embedding).
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms for the chat flow at 8 concurrent users.
- Cost/throughput: demonstrate steady-state throughput of ~60 requests/min with acceptable token cost.
- Quality: top-3 reranking precision on your eval set improves current baseline by at least 12%.

Proposed POC plan & timeline:
- Week 1 (kickoff): credentialing + SSO invites + IP allowlist + test API key.
- Week 2: baseline tests and one integration sprint; we’ll provide a standard eval harness and a small prompt set.
- Week 3: joint review of results, tuning suggestions, and decision meeting.

Ownership:
- Redwood: Marissa (AM) — project coordinator / escalation
- Redwood infra: Rishi (infra) — keys & networking provisioning
- ZetaOps: Jane (engineering lead) and Tim (security) — acceptance & test data

Immediate asks for ZetaOps to unblock Week 1:
1) Confirm the two test admin email addresses for SSO invites (SAML + SCIM if you want user sync).
2) Provide the public IP ranges that need to be whitelisted for API calls (CSV or CIDR).
3) Any specific restrictions for the API key (read-only, token limits).
4) Data residency or retention constraints we should be aware of.

Attachments: I’m attaching a draft POC success criteria doc and an IP allowlist template for you to populate.

Next steps: if you can confirm the admin emails and the IP list by EOD Wednesday (7/1), Rishi can provision test keys and I’ll send the SSO invite the following day.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0187

--
Attachment: zetaops-poc-success-criteria-v1.pdf (summary of success metrics and test plans)
Attachment: ip-allowlist-template.csv (CSV of CIDR blocks to complete)

From: Jane Lawson <jane.lawson@zetaops.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim O'Rourke <tim@zetaops.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: ZetaOps trial orchestration & access plan

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear summary.

Confirming: we’re aligned on the success criteria. A couple notes from our side before you provision anything:
- Please send SSO invites to these two people for the sandbox: sara.nguyen@zetaops.com and devops-admin@zetaops.com. Sara will be the primary integration owner.
- For IP allowlist, we can provide the ranges by COB Wednesday (7/1). We also have a separate egress gateway for some services — can you accept both direct IPs and NAT-ed ranges?
- On data residency: we need assurance that logs for the POC are retained for 30 days and stored in the US. Is that possible?
- For SSO: we prefer SAML for authentication but would like the option to enable SCIM later.
- One ask: can you extend the POC to 4 weeks instead of 3? We want room for one extra tuning sprint.

A few attachments from our side: an initial signed NDA (stub) and our internal security questionnaire (we’ll share sections relevant to infra).

If you can confirm the 30-day retention and NAT support, we’ll fill the IP template and get you the admin emails by 7/1.

Thanks,
Jane
VP Engineering, ZetaOps
jane.lawson@zetaops.com

- One test API key scoped to sandbox (rate limits: 200 rpm, token TTL 24h)

If there are any unblockers (certs, PKI, change requests), call them out. We’d like an ETA so I can communicate to Jane — they’re asking to push POC to 4 weeks, which is fine if infra can support it.

Marissa / Lauren — I can take this. Summary of next steps from infra:
1) I’ll create a ticket (INF-4921) and track API key creation + IP firewall rules + SSO metadata exchange.
2) Test API key: we’ll generate a scoped test key tied to a sandbox project. ETA: Q3 EOD Thu 7/2.
3) IP allowlist: we can accept CIDR ranges and NAT-ed gateway ranges — please provide CSV. We’ll stage entries in the firewall and enable after confirmation.
4) Logs: 30-day retention in the US is supported for hosted trials — I’ll note retention policy in the ticket.
5) SSO: for SAML we need their metadata XML and an assertion consumer URL (we’ll provide our SP metadata). For SCIM we’ll need an admin account and to enable SCIM on our tenant — that will take an additional 2 business days after metadata exchange.

Attachments: created ticket INF-4921 (link below) and added a checklist.

Open questions:
- Do we want the test API key to be IP-restricted initially? (Recommend yes for safety).
- Any special TLS cert exchange required by ZetaOps? If so, get their PKI contact.

I’ll post updates to INF-4921 as I work.

— Rishi
